results.name: PBKDF2 SHA-256 Verification & Timing-Safe Equality

results.name: Auto-Upgrade Workflow from PBKDF2 to Bcrypt

results.name: Malformed & Corrupted Hash Resilience

results.name: Failed Login Tracking & Counter Increment

results.name: Account Lockout Duration Enforcement
results.details: Account successfully locked for 15 minutes when maximum failed attempts threshold is reached.

results.name: Atomic Auth Session & Refresh Token Creation (fn_create_auth_session_atomic)

results.name: Normal Work Order UPDATE Operation

results.name: Physical DELETE on Normal WO (BEFORE DELETE RETURN NEW Behavior)
results.details: Empirical confirmation: Physical DELETE was suppressed (0 rows deleted, row preserved) because fn_protect_legacy_soft_deleted_wo returns NEW (NULL on DELETE) instead of OLD. This matches Phase 2.2 audit analysis.
